introSubheading: Choose before you play. You can change this any time from the bottom of the page.
customizeSubheading: Turn each category on or off.
introNecessary: BeatDrop always uses necessary storage to run the game and keep rounds secure.
introOptional: The optional parts remember your settings (theme, snippet length, streak) and collect anonymous usage stats. We only use them if you allow it.
readMore: Read more in the <cookies>Cookie Policy</cookies> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
preferencesOffNote: If you turn off “Preferences”, data saved on this device, such as your theme, streak and player name, is deleted as soon as you save.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Keeps game rounds secure (round token), rate-limits API calls and stores this consent choice. It can't be turned off because the game would stop working.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Remembers your theme, snippet length, chosen mode, streak and best time on this device. If off, your settings reset every time you open the game.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Helps us see which modes are played most and which pages have problems, using aggregated, anonymous data. Off by default.
